title: an_hour()'s range guard is unreachable; setup writes an hour APScheduler refuses
method: input probe + end-to-end wizard run followed by 'cura run'
observed_at_discovery: 'if not 1 <= h <= 12 and not 0 <= h <= 23' is false for every h the regex can produce, so nothing is rejected. Answering '13pm' to the evening question completed setup with 'All set. Cura is ready.' and wrote "evening_time": 25. 'python -m cura run --config ~/.cura/robert.json --dry-run' then exited 1 with an unhandled ValueError from apscheduler/triggers/cron/fields.py: "Error validating expression '25': the last value (25) is higher than the maximum value (23)" -- neither check-in is ever scheduled. pytest exit 1, 5 failed.
